question: From which country did Amazon Prime Video start its first mobile-only plan in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In India, Amazon Prime Video Mobile Edition, **a single-user, mobile-only service, was offered at an initial price of **89 rupees per month**.
 
• The over-the-top platform is launching a mobile-only package in India for the first time.
 
• Amazon Prime Video is a subscription video-on-demand over-the-top streaming and renting service operated by Amazon in the United States.
 
• It is available as a standalone service or as part of Amazon's Prime membership.
 
• The service primarily distributes Amazon Originals, which are films and television shows created or licensed by Amazon Studios and MGM Holdings.
 
• It also hosts material from other providers, content add-ons, live sporting events, and video rental and purchasing options.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Amazon**:

 
 
• Formerly: Cadabra, Inc. (1994–1995)
 
• Founded: July 5, 1994
 
• Founder: Jeff Bezos
 
• Headquarters: Seattle, Washington, U.S.
